description: This file defines the SourceMapGenerator class within the ScssPhp\ScssPhp\SourceMap namespace. It handles generating source maps for compiled SCSS/CSS code, including adding mappings, generating JSON output, and normalizing filenames. It is a core component related to source map creation in the SCSSPHP library.

classes.name: SourceMapGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for creating and managing source maps, including adding mappings, generating JSON representations, and normalizing filenames according to specified options.

methods.name: addMapping
methods.description: Adds a mapping between generated code and original source, recording line and column information for both.

methods.name: saveMap
methods.description: Saves the generated source map content to a specified file, handling directory existence and write errors.

methods.name: generateJson
methods.description: Produces the JSON-encoded source map according to the Source Map V3 specification, including mappings, sources, and optional source contents.

methods.name: getSourcesContent
methods.description: Retrieves the content of all source files associated with the source map.

methods.name: generateMappings
methods.description: Encodes and produces the string representing the mappings between generated and original code.

methods.name: findFileIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a source filename in the internal sources list.

methods.name: normalizeFilename
methods.description: Normalizes filenames for portability and consistency, including path fixing and optional trimming based on base paths.

methods.name: fixWindowsPath
methods.description: Converts Windows backslash paths to forward slashes and optionally appends a slash.
